decisions.decision: Drive cross-manifest-step transitions through steps/advance.ts and reducer.ts rather than through SurveyRunner.tsx alone
decisions.why: SurveyRunner functions only operate at the intra-flow level; steps/advance.ts shipped after this spec was written as the real manifest-level step-advance policy - using it avoids re-deriving that routing logic a second time
decisions.rejected: Flattening the whole manifest into one SurveyRunner-driven flow sequence

decisions.decision: Ship the coverage gate as report-only for this increment, defer the ratchet mode
decisions.why: A ratchet needs a committed baseline to compare against; report-only first produces that baseline honestly rather than fabricating one
decisions.rejected: Shipping the ratchet immediately with a hand-authored zero-baseline

decisions.decision: Harness drives both SurveyRunner intra-flow routing and steps/advance.ts+reducer.ts cross-manifest-step transitions, not SurveyRunner alone
decisions.why: The spec predates the Unified Survey Architecture migration; a full identity-to-package replay crosses manifest step boundaries SurveyRunners functions alone cannot resolve
decisions.rejected: Flattening the manifest into one giant flow to keep using only SurveyRunner functions, which would duplicate steps/advance.ts own routing logic

decisions.decision: Land the coverage gate as report-only, defer ratchet mode to a follow-up
decisions.why: A ratchet needs a committed baseline to diff against; generating that baseline honestly is what report-onlys first run produces
decisions.rejected: Shipping ratchet immediately with a fabricated zero-baseline

approach: Headless vitest replay harness driving SurveyRunner routing primitives for intra-step navigation and steps/advance.ts + reducer.ts for cross-manifest-step transitions (a layer the spec predates), plus a report-only coverage gate comparing buildManifestStepGraph() against per-fixture collectRenderedNodeIds(buildFlowSources()).

plan.summary: New headless journey-replay harness + report-only coverage gate; corrected two function-name drifts and one real architectural gap (manifest-level transitions) from the spec pre-migration text
